policy.reason: The old price coercion does not repair the errors the crawler actually detects. A free AI fallback has no proved intended type or published missing answer. These are local checks, not external Schema.org or Google validator verdicts.
reference_paraphrases: price accepts Number or Text; a numeric string is not invalid merely because it is quoted.
Google discontinued FAQ rich results on May 7, 2026 and removed their documentation on June 15, 2026.
policy.numeric_coercion_utility: Keep the explicit private helper and its six compatibility tests, but remove automatic bindings and fallback prompts. It is not a validation repair.

guards: Advisory precedence, removal from automatic head hints, and visible local-check dashboard labels for both families.

Individual correction, URL preview, GitHub preview and confirmed cached preview refuse after project authorization but before payer lookup, journal replay, quota, GitHub or AI. Base/indexability/uppercase/whitespace variants are covered.
Preparation, direct patch and internal execution refuse even with forged preparations, cached sources and injected price-coercion rewriters.
Normal bulk candidate selection excludes both families. A bulk report containing only this advice causes no GitHub access, PR, model work or charge; normal bulk journal/quota gates still apply.
Local scoring retains the six actual error codes and their counts, adding explicit local-check provenance and no-external-validator metadata.
Historical binding test names and parameter IDs are retained, with assertions now proving refusal of the old converter rather than approving the wrong repair. No test is removed or newly skipped.

read_only_owned_remote_countercheck.scope: Two existing native preview pages, not a whole-site crawl or a production-indexability claim. The file named schema-invalid actually contains a valid string price. FAQ positives are measured only on the owned loopback fixture.

earlier_attempts_retained.reason: Before the product change: wrong automatic claims, missing refusal guards, misleading advice and absent local provenance.
The independent countercheck mistakenly read sha instead of the existing wait_build result's head_sha, after its HTTP reads. Corrected and repeated in a new directory.

remaining_limits: Withdrawal and safe refusal are measured, not automatic JSON-LD/FAQ repair or a reduction in actual error counts.
The 62 visible offered families and zero missing named record references are not certification of all occurrences or frameworks.
No external Schema.org validator, Google Rich Results Test, paid Claude call or real correction write is exercised in this phase.
Endpoint tests use isolated SQLite and in-memory providers/GitHub; PostgreSQL-specific cases remain skipped as before.
No customer site, production main or agent deployment is modified. No universal client-readiness or production-indexability certification.
